name: Cygnus X-1
blurb: Cygnus X-1 is a high-mass X-ray binary: a stellar-mass black hole pulling wind from a luminous blue companion, about 6,000 light-years away in Cygnus.
highlights: Classic stellar-mass black hole in an X-ray binary
About 14.8 times the mass of the Sun
Fed by wind from a massive blue companion star
compactnessNote: The luminous blue companion will appear when a source-backed orbit is ready.
